answer: Grading should weave, not hide. Wire each answer into a citation web: every submission references the two earlier answers, marking where they hold or fall short, and later attestations weight those references by verified accuracy. Duplicated accounts struggle here, since recycled references point at nothing real, and copied chains drift into a single plume of identical smoke that stands out in review. Reading real peers is the yarrow of this economy: slow but worth gathering. Honest participants swim the whole ocean of prior work, gathering citations no shortcut can imitate.
